title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Music Hall on 1976-06-09
lineage: aud 1st gen reel lineage: mac>reels @ 7.5 ips, dolby b set I on maxell 7" reel, set II on ampex 10.5" (baked), technics rs-1506>teac an-180>hd-p2 24/48>cd wave>flac

ai_review.summary: A pleasantly mellow ’76 Dead tape with a soft, slightly cloudy sound that enhances the overall vibe.
ai_review.review: The reviewer finds this recording to be one of the most enjoyable Dead tapes, citing its gentle timbral quality and the contrast between interesting jams and extreme mellowness – exactly what they love about the 1976 era. Although the audio is described as “partly cloudy,” that lo‑fi character actually adds to the tape’s charm.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one five‑star review; strong praise for musical vibe but limited detail on specific performance or technical aspects, leading to a high but cautiously estimated rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audio is described as ‘partly cloudy’ with a soft overall timbral quality; the lo‑fi character is seen as enhancing the mellow feel rather than detracting from listenability.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is praised for its blend of interesting jams and extreme mellowness, embodying the sweet folk‑rock vibe characteristic of the 1976 Dead.
